verdict.rationale: Square has no documented first-class automation builder or background agent. Background workflows are only possible indirectly: you build your own service that reacts to webhook event notifications, or you rely on built-in recurring mechanisms such as the Subscriptions API and custom fraud rules and alerts that run automatically. The MCP server and Square AI support interactive, on-demand agent use rather than scheduled or autonomous runs. Missing for 10: a native no-code or AI automation and scheduling feature, documentation of agent-driven background execution, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
